summary: Enhance your leadership skills with this Emotional Intelligence Training Course. Learn to connect, inspire, and lead effectively in any environment.
lede: Emotional intelligence training helps people managers and team leads apply emotional skills to day-to-day leadership. Participants practice recognizing emotional triggers, managing stress, listening with empathy, resolving conflict, and fostering psychological safety, then use these skills to handle difficult conversations and plan improvements to team dynamics.
audienceIntro: This program is essential for professionals who operate at the intersection of people management and operational delivery.
modules: Foundations of Emotional Intelligence in Leadership
EQ in the Digital and Hybrid Workplace
Coaching and Developing Others with EQ
Strategic EQ Integration and Action Planning
prerequisites: This course is designed for professionals in leadership or management roles. Participants should have at least two years of experience managing teams or leading projects. No prior formal psychological training is required, though a willingness to engage in self-reflective assessments and peer-to-peer feedback is essential for success.
